summary: Full pass on the new hospital data (12 hospitals incl. AAS Medicare + Patiala Heart Institute), the voice endpoints, and the Symptom Triage voice UI hooks. Backend voice tests (4/4) and triage regression tests (2/2) pass. Frontend verified: hero counts dynamic (12 hospitals / 138+ doctors), 5 richly-updated hospitals render address/phone/email/emergency banner/specialty chips/doctor bios, doctor+specialty search finds new-hospital doctors, chest-pain triage redirects to /emergency showing all 5 emergency-ready hospitals with ICU info + emergency phone + Google Maps directions + unverified disclaimer, mic button toggles to 'Listening... tap the square to stop' without crashing, Listen button appears on routine triage result and successfully calls POST /api/voice/speak (200). Mobile 390px has 0px horizontal overflow on both expanded hospital cards and emergency screen. Triage did not fabricate any hospital names; all doctors quoted come from the supplied directory.
critical_code_review_comments: Doctor+specialty search is a substring match — Park Hospital cardiologists have specialization 'Cardiac Sciences' so a user searching 'Cardiology' will not surface them (only Patiala Heart Institute cardiologists). Consider synonym/alias mapping (Cardiac Sciences ↔ Cardiology, ENT ↔ Otolaryngology) to improve recall. Not a bug per se, but a UX gap in the new directory.
voice.py writes STT upload to /tmp then removes it — good — but no size limit enforced beyond FastAPI defaults; consider adding a max content-length guard to prevent large-file abuse.
voice.py catches all exceptions as 502 with the raw error string in detail; consider sanitising to avoid leaking upstream provider messages to clients.
api.js is at 162 lines with a large embedded hospital dataset; still readable but if more hospitals are added it should move to a JSON file for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None; used static frontend directory + generated audio via /api/voice/speak for STT roundtrip test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice endpoints work end-to-end; TTS returns audio/mpeg with valid MP3 header (ID3/0xFF), STT roundtrips text correctly. Mic UI records in Chromium test env (permission auto-granted). Use headers with User-Agent to bypass Cloudflare 1010 on preview URL. All required data-testids present: symptom-mic-button, triage-listen-button.
